profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at ServiceNow
profile.summary: Designing and creating better cloud-based software platforms. I specialize in scalable REST Architecture, AWS and build automation.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Building a scalable search platform to power search inside the ServiceNow cloud.

Key Responsibilities:

Re-platforming and scalability of search.

positions.title: Senior DevOps Cloud Engineer (purchased by ServiceNow)
positions.description:
Designing and implementing best practices for automated tests, builds, deployments, and scalability.

Using terraform to automate AWS cloud deployment. 

Handling low level application changes:

Upgrading the JRE to Java 11 from 8. 
Upgrading of various dependencies. 
Building python based binaries to allow our code to run on Windows.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developing backend solutions (Java 8, DI, NoSql/Cassandra, RESTful APIs) for web-based applications. 

Day to day: I am working on building microservices, features, tools and fixing bugs for the betterment of open source and internal EF software.

Worked on open source projects and was able to commit on libraries such as fabric8 and Kubernetes. Built and owned tooling to manage Kubernetes deployment.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
Engineering solutions for various customer workflows in a Java/MySQL/XML/XSLT/Tomcat environment. 

Main duties involve performing systems integration work to connect RAMP technologies with other platforms such as the Platform, BrightCove, Drupal, Ooyala and other various CMS technologies. 

Day to day: Processing XML/JSON payloads to ingest, process, post-back and categorize Text/Audio/Video data. Answering a large volume of queries from internal and external resources.

positions.title: Customer Support Engineer
positions.description:
Main customer facing point of contact for all support issues regarding the RAMP Media Cloud.

In depth troubleshooting, requiring well rounded knowledge of Java/SQL and Apache Tomcat.

Part time Java and Web (HTML/CSS/XML/XSL/JavaScript) development.

positions.title: Application Support Services (Contractor)
positions.description: Assisted in the Development, Support, Administration and Upgrade of the BiogenIdec PlanisWare Platform.

positions.title: Application Support Engineer I
positions.description: Resolve time-sensitive customer facing and internal tickets (troubleshooting SQL servers, dictation servers and voice recognition software) through phone and email.

positions.title: SharePoint Admin
positions.description: I work on Excel spreadsheets doing some VBA coding as well as act as technical support for the SharePoint site I created to help manage the IT asset inventory for PCI/PI/SOX compliance. I also help to debug errors in the SpreadSheet or make updates when needed.

positions.title: Enrollment Counselor
positions.description: Making 100 daily outbound calls to prospective students and counseling them on the benefits of higher education with the hopes of inspiring them towards the pursuit of a bachelor's degree program.
